# The commit from which the identity and host-path gate applies.

# This repository began with a single initialization commit, so there is no
# pre-baseline history to freeze: the baseline anchors the gate at the
# repository's first commit, and every commit after it is audited forward from

# is not on the approved list in approved-git-identities.txt, and on any
